item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: “Burning love”, crisp-fried bacon and caramelised onions on silky mashed potatoes and topped with chopped herbs. Served with pickled gherkins and pickled beetroot. (6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Quzi, Iraq’s national dish, whole lamb slow-roasted overnight in warm spices, served out in the restaurant with spiced rice and soured yoghurt. (6+8+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Roasted tofu in the same warm spices, served with spiced rice and a soured yoghurt. (6+7+8+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Porchetta arrosto, crisp and juicy porchetta served on oven-roasted potatoes and root vegetables, finished with a green mojo sauce of roasted green peppers and plenty of herbs. (15) GREEN DISH: Dish Halloumi served on oven-roasted potatoes and root vegetables, finished with a green mojo sauce of roasted green peppers and plenty of herbs. (6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: French-inspired roasted chicken with pommes anna and a creamy mushroom sauce flavoured with tarragon and topped with pea shoots. Served with haricots verts with lemon. The dish is gluten free. (6+15) GREEN DISH: Dish French-inspired roasted tofu with pommes anna and a creamy mushroom sauce flavoured with tarragon and topped with pea shoots. Served with haricots verts with lemon. The dish is gluten free. (6+7+15)
